items.q: What do you need from me to get started?
items.a: Just a short brief: what your business does, what you sell or offer, and a few websites you like. Logo, photos and product details can be shared as we go.

items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: It depends on the size of the project. After we talk, you get a clear timeline before any work starts.

items.q: Will my website work on mobile?
items.a: Yes. Every site is designed mobile-first and tested on real phone and desktop screens.

items.q: Can I update the website myself later?
items.a: Yes. Stores are managed from the Shopify or WooCommerce dashboard, and we'll show you how to update products and content. For portfolio and landing pages, we can also handle updates for you.

items.q: Do you help with domain and hosting?
items.a: Yes. We can guide you through buying a domain and setting up hosting, and connect everything for you.
Send a message on WhatsApp or use the form below. We'll reply, discuss your idea and share the next steps.
